title: Target engagement and efficacy in disease-modifying trials of synuclein-related disorders
title_zh: 针对α-突触核蛋白相关疾病的疾病修饰试验中的靶点结合与疗效
abstract: Abstract Disease-modifying trials in Parkinson’s disease (PD), multiple system atrophy (MSA), and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB) increasingly incorporate fluid and imaging biomarkers to demonstrate target engagement, de-risk subsequent phases of drug development and provide mechanistic evidence of biological activity. Whether biomarker modulation predicts clinical benefit remains unclear. We conducted a PRISMA-compliant review of phase II and III disease-modifying trials (2020-2025) that included at least one biomarker intended to assess target engagement. Twenty-six trials met inclusion criteria (PD=19, MSA=4, DLB=3; n=2,195 participants). Target engagement was reported in 14 of 19 PD trials (12 phase II/2 phase III), 1 of 4 MSA trials, and 2 of 3 DLB trials (all phase II). Concordance between target engagement and clinical improvement was uncommon, as only 8/26 studies (7 phase II/1 phase III) demonstrated both target engagement and statistically significant clinical benefit, and just two of these (both phase II, one in PD and one in MSA) were rigorously controlled with low or moderate risk of bias. Nine trials showed target engagement without clinical benefit, whereas two reported clinical improvement without measurable target engagement. Baseline biomarker-guided patient selection was uncommon and rarely aligned with the compound’s mechanism of action. Patient-reported outcomes were widely used but rarely improved. Across recent disease-modifying trials in PD, DLB, and MSA, target engagement was frequently demonstrated, yet clinical benefit rarely followed. These findings question the predictive value of currently used target-engagement biomarkers and highlight the need to biologically align trial populations with the mechanisms targeted by experimental molecular interventions.
abstract_zh: 摘要：在帕金森病（PD）、多系统萎缩（MSA）和路易体痴呆（DLB）的疾病修饰试验中，越来越多地使用体液和影像生物标志物来证明靶点结合、降低后续药物开发阶段的风险，并提供生物活性机制证据。生物标志物调节是否能预测临床获益仍不清楚。我们对2020-2025年期间包含至少一种用于评估靶点结合的生物标志物的II期和III期疾病修饰试验进行了符合PRISMA标准的综述。共有26项试验符合纳入标准（PD=19，MSA=4，DLB=3；共计2,195名受试者）。在19项PD试验中，有14项报告了靶点结合（12项II期/2项III期），4项MSA试验中仅1项，3项DLB试验中有2项（均为II期）报告了靶点结合。靶点结合与临床改善的一致性很少，仅有8/26项研究（7项II期/1项III期）同时显示靶点结合和统计学显著的临床获益，其中仅有两项（均为II期，一项在PD，一项在MSA）经过严格控制，偏倚风险低或中等。九项试验显示靶点结合但无临床获益，另有两项报告临床改善但未测得可量化的靶点结合。基线生物标志物指导的患者筛选很少见，且很少与药物作用机制相符。患者报告的结局广泛使用，但很少出现改善。在近期PD、DLB和MSA的疾病修饰试验中，靶点结合经常被证明，但临床获益很少随之出现。这些发现质疑目前使用的靶点结合生物标志物的预测价值，并强调需要将试验人群在生物学上与实验分子干预所针对的机制相匹配。
